title: Space Shape V2 Tree Purity Retrofit
description: Retrofit the already-migrated 🪐️space plugin (✏️s/🔌️plugins/🪐️space, crate semio-s-plugin-space) onto the newly-amended Shape V2 tree-purity rule per master ticket 26/08/05/CRATE-CONSOLIDATION-AND-PLUGIN-TAXONOMY-RESTRUCTURE §14. Pure mechanical reshape, no logic changes: (1) move 📦️lib.rs into 📦️packages/🦀️rust/📦️lib.rs, update [lib] path and add ../../ prefix to every #[path], (2) fold sibling variant files (🎛️apps/🏠️home/🦀️config.rs, 🦀️terminology.rs; 🎛️apps/🪐️space/🦀️config.rs, 🦀️terminology.rs, 🦀️engine.rs) into their own component folders (🎚️config, 🗣️terminology, ⚙️engine per established repo convention), (3) confirm no nested data/docs need relocating (top-level 📚️examples already correctly placed; 🫀️core and 🗿️artifacts already compliant). Verify with cargo check/clippy/test, confirm test count matches pre-retrofit baseline.
summary:
Retrofitted the already-migrated 🪐️space plugin onto Shape V2 tree purity: (1) moved 📦️lib.rs into 📦️packages/🦀️rust/📦️lib.rs, updated [lib] path from "../../📦️lib.rs" to "📦️lib.rs", and prefixed all 38 non-"." #[path] strings with "../../"; (2) folded 5 sibling variant files (🎛️apps/🏠️home/🦀️config.rs, 🦀️terminology.rs; 🎛️apps/🪐️space/🦀️config.rs, 🦀️terminology.rs, 🦀️engine.rs) into their own component folders (🎚️config, 🗣️terminology, ⚙️engine — matching the naming convention already established by vcs/mathematical/imperative/playbook/lowpoly retrofits) and updated the corresponding #[path] declarations. No data/docs relocation was needed: recon confirmed the top-level 📚️examples/ was already correctly placed, no nested 📚️examples/🧫️fixtures/🤖️generated/🛂️manifest.json existed inside the tree, and no AGENTS.md/README.md existed anywhere in the plugin (no collision). 🫀️core and 🗿️artifacts were already Shape-V2-compliant and untouched. 🔨️modules left out of scope per instructions.

Verification: live cargo check/test (-p semio-s-plugin-space) is blocked repo-wide by 📕️norm's in-flight migration leaving a dangling workspace-member manifest path (confirmed NOT caused by this retrofit — the identical error reproduces on an untouched plugin, semio-s-plugin-vcs, before and after this change; retried near end of session, still blocked). Did full manual verification instead: (a) byte-diffed the moved lib.rs against its pre-move git HEAD content with #[path] lines excluded — zero diff, logic untouched; (b) byte-diffed all 5 moved sibling files against their pre-move git HEAD versions — zero diff on each, content moved verbatim; (c) resolved all 38 #[path] targets in the new lib.rs against the filesystem relative to its new location — all 38 resolve to real files; (d) confirmed the [lib] path in Cargo.toml resolves to the moved file; (e) confirmed tree purity via find — only 🎛️apps, 🫀️core, 🗿️artifacts (plain folders), 📦️packages, 📚️examples (root-level, untouched), and out-of-scope 🔨️modules remain under the owner root, no stray files. grep across the repo found no external references to the old owner-root 📦️lib.rs path, so registrar handoff is empty.
